front: ERA test la gi va dua tren co so nao?
back: Endometrial Receptivity Analysis (ERA) la test transcriptomic phan tich bieu hien 238 gen trong mau sinh thiet noi mac, dung machine learning classifier phan loai noi mac thanh Receptive / Pre-receptive / Post-receptive. Duoc phat trien boi Carlos Simon (Igenomix, 2011). Co so: WOI (Window of Implantation) chi khoang 48-72h, neu embryo transfer truot WOI -> RIF.

front: Window of Implantation (WOI) la gi? Timing chinh xac theo tung protocol?
back: WOI = cua so sinh hoc 48-72h trong secretory muon khi noi mac receptive. Timing: True NC: LH surge + 6 ngay (blastocyst). Modified NC: hCG trigger + 7 ngay. HRT cycle: P (progesterone) + 5 ngay

front: ESHRE 2023 dinh nghia Recurrent Implantation Failure (RIF) nhu the nao?
back: RIF = chuyen phoi viable nhieu lan that bai, du de can dieu tra/can thiep them. Cu the: >= 3 lan ET that bai (beta-hCG am tinh), HOAC >= 2 lan neu phoi chat luong tot (euploid blastocyst). Phoi phai danh gia viable (hinh the tot, phat trien dung ngay). Tinh den tuoi me

front: Ti le WOI displacement o benh nhan RIF la bao nhieu? Dang nao pho bien nhat?
back: WOI displacement: 28% (Zheng 2025, PMID 40221820) den 73% (Edimiris 2023, PMID 37261585). Phan bo: Pre-receptive: 50-75% (pho bien nhat), Early receptive: ~24%, Post-receptive: ~2-5%. Da so WOI displacement la pre-receptive -> can THEM progesterone 12-24h.

front: 3 dang WOI theo ERA test va xu tri tuong ung?
back: 1. Receptive (~25-50% RIF): WOI dung P+5 -> ET protocol chuan. 2. Pre-receptive (~50-75%): WOI muon hon -> them progesterone 12-24h (pET). 3. Post-receptive (~5%): WOI som hon -> rut progesterone (pET). 4. Early receptive: trung gian -> pET ca nhoi

front: ERA co cai thien live birth rate khong? Tom tat evidence?
back: Evidence mau thuan. TICH CUC: Simon 2020 RCT (PMID 32723696) cumulative LBR 71.2% PET vs 55.4% FET vs 48.9% Fresh. Zheng 2025 (PMID 40221820) LBR 53.3% ERT vs 30% control o RIF. TRUNG LAP: Arian 2023 meta-analysis 8 studies n=2784 (PMID 36414088): OR 1.38 (0.79-2.41), khong khac biet. Edimiris 2023 (PMID 37261585): pregnancy 49% pET vs 44% standard, p=NS. KET LUAN: ERA co loi o mot so cohort RIF, khong loi o population chung. ESHRE 2023 khong khuyen cao thuong quy.

front: Quy trinh thuc hien ERA test?
back: 1. Chuan bi noi mac bang HRT cycle gia lap (E2 -> P4). 2. Sinh thiet noi mac vao P+5 (120h sau bat dau progesterone). 3. RNA extraction + sequencing (hoac microarray). 4. Phan tich bioinformatic -> ket qua WOI o dau, ET doi bao nhieu gio. 5. pET: chu ky FET sau dung cung HRT nhung doi gio ET theo ERA result
extra: Sinh thiet qua catheter Pipelle hoac Novak

front: Natural Cycle vs HRT cho FET - bang chung moi nhat?
back: COMPETE RCT 2025 (PMID 40561125, n=902): LBR 54% NC vs 43% HRT, RR 1.26 (1.10-1.44), NC uu viet. BMJ RCT Wei 2026 (PMID 41565309, n=4376): Healthy LBR 41.6% NC vs 40.6% HRT, RR 1.03 (0.96-1.10), p=0.49 - KHONG khac biet. Nhung NC giam pre-eclampsia. Kornilov 2024 (PMID 39244908): P4mNC vs HRT o euploid blastocyst, khong khac biet. NC uu tien cho phu nu ovulatory deu; HRT van OK neu can flexibility.

front: HRT cycle trong FET co tang nguy co pre-eclampsia khong? Cach phong ngua?
back: CO. HRT cycle khong co corpus luteum -> giam angiogenic factors (VEGF, PlGF) + tang sFlt-1 -> tang nguy co pre-eclampsia. Meta-analysis cho thay RR ~1.5-2. PHONG NGU: Aspirin 81-162 mg/ngay tu 12-16 tuan thai (theo USPSTF, ACOG, ASRM) cho moi HRT-FET pregnancy. NC cycle co corpus luteum tu nhien -> giam pre-eclampsia risk.

front: hCG intrauterine co hieu qua trong RIF khong? Bang chung?
back: CO. Meta-analysis 2024 (PMID 38982352, Luo X et al., 13 studies, n=2,157 benh nhan RIF theo ESHRE 2023): Cai thien clinical pregnancy rate (CPR), cai thien embryo implantation rate, khong tang miscarriage rate. Co che: kich thich decidualization, keo dai WOI, tang hCG receptors o noi mac. Lieu: 500-1000 IU, truoc ET 3-7 ngay. Can nhac o cac nuoc dang phat trien (cost-effective).

front: Liet ke 4 protocol chuan bi noi mac cho FET va dac diem chinh?
back: 1. True Natural Cycle (tNC): theo doi LH tu nhien, ET LH+7. Cho phu nu ovulatory deu. 2. Modified NC (mNC): trigger hCG khi follicle du, ET hCG+7. 3. HRT / Artificial Cycle: E2 -> P4, ET P+5. Tang pre-eclampsia. 4. Mild Ovarian Stimulation: letrozole/clomiphene + trigger. Co corpus luteum. 5. P4-modified NC: NC + progesterone ho tro.

front: Khi nao nen chi dinh ERA test theo ESHRE 2023?
back: ESHRE 2023 KHONG khuyen cao ERA thuong quy (PMID 37332387). CAN NHAC ERA khi: >= 3 FET that bai voi phoi viable, dac biet neu phoi euploid (PGT-A binh thuong), da loai tru nguyen nhan khac, benh nhan hieu va chap nhan evidence mau thuan, co kha nang chi tra (1,500-3,000 USD/test)

front: Molecular signature cua WOI gom nhung thanh phan nao?
back: Cytokines/chemokines: LIF, IL-6, IL-11, CXCL12. Adhesion molecules: integrins (alpha-V-beta-3, alpha-1-beta-1), selectins, cadherins. Glycoproteins: glycodelin, MUC-1. Morphology: pinopodes. Decidualization: stromal -> decidual cells. LncRNAs: 742 candidates (PMID 38875127). MicroRNAs (uterine fluid): biomarker tiem nang (PMID 38641194)

front: Co che tai sao hCG intrauterine co the cai thien RIF outcomes?
back: hCG (human Chorionic Gonadotropin) tiem vao tu cung: 1. Kich thich decidualization cua stromal cells. 2. Keo dai WOI bang cach tang progesterone receptors. 3. Tang hCG/LH receptors o noi mac -> tang sensitivity. 4. Dieu hoa immune: tang Treg cells, giam NK cells cytotoxic. 5. Tang angiogenic factors (VEGF) -> cai thien vascularity. Lieu 500-1000 IU truoc ET 3-7 ngay.

front: Tai sao ERA co the that bai o mot so ca RIF? (3 ly do chinh)
back: 1. Intra-cycle variability: WOI co the thay doi theo tung chu ky, ERA chi do 1 thoi diem. 2. HRT khac Natural Cycle: ERA sinh thiet trong HRT cycle nhung FET co the NC -> hormonal milieu khac, WOI estimate co the sai. 3. pET margin qua nho: pET chi doi +/- 12-24h, co the khong du bat kip WOI that. ERA khong phai magic bullet, can ca nhoi hoa.

front: Biomarker moi nao dang duoc nghien cuu cho endometrial receptivity?
back: 1. Uterine fluid miRNAs (PMID 38641194): non-invasive. 2. Exosomes tu noi mac: chua miRNA + protein. 3. LncRNAs 742 candidates (PMID 38875127). 4. AI-enhanced RNA-seq (ERT, PMID 40221820). 5. Metabolomics uterine fluid: lactate, glucose, amino acids. 6. Microbiome noi mac: Lactobacillus dominance. Tat ca dang o research phase.

Trong FET True Natural Cycle, thoi diem embryo transfer toi uu la {{c1::LH surge + 6 ngay}} cho blastocyst.
Trong FET Modified Natural Cycle, thoi diem embryo transfer toi uu la {{c1::hCG trigger + 7 ngay}} cho blastocyst.
WOI displacement dang pho bien nhat la {{c1::pre-receptive}} (50-75% ca RIF) -> can them progesterone 12-24h.
ESHRE 2023 dinh nghia RIF la chuyen phoi viable that bai {{c1::>= 3 lan}} (hoac >= 2 lan neu phoi euploid).
Trong HRT-FET, de giam nguy co pre-eclampsia, can cho aspirin {{c1::81-162 mg/ngay}} tu tuan 12-16 thai ky.
